name: Press Sheet
blurb: Straight off the press, over the one piece of production furniture that still reads at thumbnail size: the ink bar.

name: Letterpress
blurb: Ink and impression. The plate struck deep into cotton stock, paper lipping up around the bite.

name: Hot Foil
blurb: Stamped in metal on dark linen board. Each half keeps its own hue, translated into a single directional foil sweep.

name: Ben Day
blurb: A coarse mechanical dot screen run edge to edge, clearing around the mark's own silhouette.

name: Die Cut
blurb: The mark cut clean through a paper disc, with a two-tone board underneath returning the brand colours.

name: Reverse
blurb: A solid flood of BHD cyan with the mark lifted straight out of it to bare stock, and a yellow trap along one edge.

name: Module
blurb: The mark is drawn on a 30.41-unit square grid. This lays that grid back over the sheet and fills four of its cells.

name: Brayer
blurb: One pass of a hand roller. The band runs off both sides, so only its torn top and bottom edges are in frame.

name: Stamp
blurb: A two-pad rubber stamp struck once on kraft. Two pads, because one ink fuses the Arabic and Latin blocks.

name: Midnight
blurb: Nothing but the mark, full colour, on tinted near-black, inside one hairline that echoes the circular crop.

name: Sunset
blurb: Dusk over the Gulf: indigo sky into rose and amber, cream Arabic over deep-indigo BHD.

name: Riso
blurb: A two-drum risograph print in fluorescent pink and blue, laid slightly off register over yellow.

name: Emerald & Gold
blurb: Gold-leaf Arabic and ivory BHD on jewel green, inside a thin gold ring.

name: Neon
blurb: Tube signage at night: pink Arabic and cyan BHD glowing on deep violet.

name: Extrude
blurb: The mark cut as a solid block of type, casting a long shadow across coral.

name: Split
blurb: Navy and tangerine halves. The Arabic swaps ink as it crosses the seam.

name: Aurora
blurb: Soft fields of purple, teal, pink and amber drifting behind a white and yellow mark.

name: Terrazzo
blurb: Omani sand stone with chips of terracotta, teal, mustard and slate.

name: Sticker
blurb: A die-cut vinyl sticker, white-bordered, on a pink pop sunburst.

name: Clay
blurb: The mark sculpted in soft pink and violet clay on a lilac ground.

name: Paper Rings
blurb: Stacked paper discs in a warm red to gold spectrum around a cream centre.

name: Holo
blurb: An iridescent foil sweep behind a dark violet and ink mark.
